title: Vibe coded a funny action game where you can even put your own face on the main character and play.
author: Lazy-Shine-9183
selftext:
Hello!

I vibe coded a game inspired by Getamped. it's my favorite childhood game and known for its exaggerated, funny facial expressions and slapstick hit reactions.

Play link: [https://savecity.vizuo.work/](https://savecity.vizuo.work/)

The game has:

* you can put your own face on the main character
* two maps: Seoul and Wai-kiki
* four different fight styles
* gorilla transformation
* rideable robots
* bazooka flying
* boss fights

Any thoughts are welcomed!

Thanks!

comments.author: Lopsided_Weakness_63
comments.body: That looks fun. Are you sure that you vibe coded that?

replies.author: Lazy-Shine-9183
replies.body: Thank you! Yes only Codex. It took almost a month.

comments.author: Lopsided_Weakness_63
comments.body: It's got that 90s vibe style too it. Like Gotcha Force. When do you think you'll be done?

replies.author: Lazy-Shine-9183
replies.body: Thank you! It was just toy project or test. So I guess I’m done already haha if you like this game, Not sure it’s available in your country though, You can play “Getamped”. Unfortunately doesn’t support MacOS which I am using, so I made clone on web 🙃

comments.author: Trashy_io
comments.body: Very cool! whats it built in? I like the art design choice as well, feels perfect for the game play

replies.author: Lazy-Shine-9183
replies.body: The face and Map is I made using AI. body and items are from original game!

replies.author: Trashy_io
replies.body: Very neat, did you use an engine?

replies.author: Trashy_io
replies.body: Very nice! after I get done with 2D thats next my list of things to try/learn

replies.author: Lazy-Shine-9183
replies.body: Thank you 😄 Have fun with your next project!

comments.author: cubman3134
comments.body: Were the art assets AI generated?? If so, how?

replies.author: Lazy-Shine-9183
replies.body:
Most of assets are designed by original game. I give the design to AI and AI re-generated. 
In detail, I made internal 3d editor in the game and changed pixel by pixel..

comments.author: kevinnnyip
comments.body: I'm sorry, but the assets and gameplay logic look straight out of GetAmped 1 from AsiaSoft.

replies.author: Lazy-Shine-9183
replies.body: Ohh I am glad to meet someone knows Getamped. Yes it ended up becoming a GetAmped clone. I originally planned to combine its fun elements into something new though.
